purpose: Decide which single real existing source family may be admitted for the next deterministic materializer PR.

decision_rationale: Already structured closer to source units than raw Markdown or corpus documents.
Can be materialized diagnostically without extraction, alias resolution, or inferred relationships.
Avoids making assumptions about the future Tiptap canonical document model.
Can produce useful coverage reports before any retrieval behavior changes.
gate_decision.next_pr_title: graph-memory: add session-memory sentence-unit materializer v0

candidate_source_families.label: Session-memory JSONL sentence/source-unit records
allowed_read_surfaces: explicit session-memory JSONL fixture or configured path only

candidate_source_families.label: Activated or manifest-backed retrieval records
candidate_source_families.defer_reason: Manifest records are close to retrieval behavior and should wait until session-memory source-unit materialization reporting is proven.

candidate_source_families.label: Markdown source documents
candidate_source_families.defer_reason: Markdown source parsing may conflict with future Tiptap canonical document model and should not be first.

candidate_source_families.label: Canonical corpus files
candidate_source_families.defer_reason: Canonical corpus mutation and broad corpus scanning remain forbidden in early ladder work.

candidate_source_families.label: Tiptap canonical document structures
candidate_source_families.defer_reason: Tiptap backend model is not the source contract for this ladder yet.

candidate_source_families.label: Live-play and activated runtime records
candidate_source_families.defer_reason: Live/runtime surfaces are too close to production behavior for first materialization.
